mainEntity.name: What should a recruitment budget include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Relevant internal recruiting costs, external sourcing expenses, assessments and other approved hiring expenditures. Employee compensation after joining is usually tracked separately.

mainEntity.name: Is recruitment budget the same as payroll budget?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Recruitment spending and ongoing employee compensation are generally planned separately.

mainEntity.name: Can the calculator support bulk hiring?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Employers can enter planned headcount and relevant recruitment cost assumptions to model bulk hiring budgets.

mainEntity.name: Does the calculator estimate EarlyJobs fees?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. It models user-provided recruitment expenses and does not represent a commercial quotation or EarlyJobs pricing.
